Project Overview
This proposal outlines three related work streams for Minuteman Press Uptown:
Phase 1: A fully functional e-commerce site for Minuteman, built on the existing prototype and hosted on Minuteman's own servers.
Phase 2: Migration of existing product data, Stripe payment integration, sales tax setup, and full public launch.
Phase 3: An ongoing service line where Minuteman offers branded client storefronts - filtered views of its own catalog tagged for individual customers - as a recurring revenue stream.
Phases are independently priced and may be approved together or separately.
Phase 1 - Minuteman Commerce Site Build
Investment: $4,000 - Target Completion: July 15-31, 2026
Phase 1 delivers the core commerce platform based on the existing prototype, including:
Customer-facing storefront with branding, navigation, and up to twelve (12) products populated.
Admin/back-office interface for product management, order tracking, and content updates.
Billing and payment processing module with checkout flow.
Basic on-page SEO setup: meta titles, meta descriptions, image alt text, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, and Google Search Console submission.
Connection to QuickBooks Online where API support permits.
Connection to Flex where integration is feasible.
Site setup and deployment on Minuteman's servers.
Initial system support and data protection measures configured at launch.
Hardware and equipment costs are the responsibility of Client and are billed separately by the equipment vendor.
Phase 2 - Migration, Payment, and Full Launch
Investment: $2,000 - Target Completion: Last week of July 2026
Phase 2 completes the launch by migrating data, wiring payments and tax, and refining the live experience:
Import of additional products pulled from Minuteman's existing site(s) into the new platform.
Stripe payment links established and tested across all relevant products.
Sales tax system configured for applicable jurisdictions and verified through end-to-end test transactions.
Full site live with existing customer data and product catalog.
One (1) post-launch tweak session within thirty (30) days of go-live to refine layout, copy, or workflow based on real-world use.
Phase 3 - Client Storefronts Service
Investment: $300 to $850 setup per storefront - Quoted per project

Phase 3 turns the Minuteman commerce site into a recurring revenue stream. A "client storefront" is NOT a separate website - it is a branded, filtered view of the Minuteman catalog tagged for a specific customer. The client's storefront uses the same checkout, the same fulfillment pipeline, and the same product inventory as Minuteman's main site, with the client's logo, curated product selection, and optional custom imagery layered on top.

This model lets Minuteman win the website business it has been losing - without rebuilding a new site for every customer. Three tiers are available, priced to give Minuteman healthy margin while staying well below competing market rates:

Adding Products to an Existing Client Storefront

After a client storefront is live, additional products may be added at $25 per product. This fee covers product tagging, listing copy adjustments, image swap (if needed), and storefront configuration.
Bulk additions (10 or more products at once) may be quoted at a discounted rate.
Custom product photography or design work is billed separately at the hourly rate below.
Standard turnaround is five (5) business days from approval.
Additional Website Work Outside This Agreement

Website work outside the scope of Phases 1, 2, and 3 - including custom features, integrations, design overhauls, troubleshooting, and post-launch maintenance - is billed at $125 per hour. Before any additional work begins, CARES Consulting will deliver a written estimate of anticipated time and total cost. No additional work will commence until Client provides written approval.
Examples of work typically billed at the hourly rate include:
New features or modules added to the Minuteman commerce site after Phase 2 launch.
Third-party integrations beyond QuickBooks Online, Flex, and Stripe.
Custom design or layout changes after the post-launch tweak session has been used.
Migration of additional legacy data not covered in Phase 2 scope.
Troubleshooting and maintenance outside scheduled support windows.

Sidebar Note

Phase 3 pricing is built to win business. At $300 setup for Basic, Minuteman can comfortably resell at $750 and still come in well under the previous $2,500 price point. Standard at $500 supports a $1,250 resale; Premium at $850 supports a $1,750 resale. Every tier protects Minuteman's margin while making the offering an obvious yes for the customer.
